description: Machine-readable metadata contract for one immutable Runtime Lab experiment record. The JSON object lives as strict JSON front matter between the leading --- delimiters of automation/knowledge/experiments/issue-<ISSUE>-run-<RUN_ID>.md. This schema is the interoperability and documentation contract; runtime code enforces the same domain invariants directly in stdlib-only Python (see automation/knowledge_catalog.py) instead of embedding a generic JSON-Schema engine.

$schema.description: Repo-relative pointer to this schema document.

base_commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase git SHA the run was based on.

issue.description: GitHub issue number this run executed.

record_id.description: Deterministic identity derived from issue and run id: issue-<ISSUE>-run-<RUN_ID>. Must agree with the record filename.

run_id.description: Automation run identifier (GitHub run id). Stored as a string.

supersedes.description: Record IDs whose conclusions this record supersedes. History is never rewritten; newer records supersede older ones.

topic.description: Short subsystem topic slug (for example render-lifecycle).

title: Runtime Lab experiment record metadata
